title: A Vector for the Gravity
author: Sable Ashgrove
blurb: Felix Joubert, a terraformer tending a garden meant for people not yet born, maintains the beacon nobody remembers commissioning. But when a ship returns from deep space with everyone aboard aged backward, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must deliver a message that will end the war — or start it before Earth's last transmission loop ends.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
